individual-data-points.explanation: Panel A is a spatial heatmap-style overlay of per-spot deconvolution scores on tissue sections, functionally equivalent to a heatmap, so individual data points are not required.

error-bars-defined.explanation: The spatial plots show color-coded deconvolution scores per spot with no error bars or box-plot elements requiring definition.

individual-data-points.explanation: Individual sample points are overlaid as jittered dots on top of the box plots.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: The box plots represent the distribution of values for each group, extending from the 25th percentile to the 75th percentile
error-bars-defined.explanation: The caption defines the box as spanning the 25th-75th percentile (IQR) and additionally reports minima/maxima values for each group, adequately describing the box and whisker elements.

individual-data-points.explanation: The GSEA enrichment plots are line plots, which are exempt from the requirement to show individual data points.

error-bars-defined.explanation: The enrichment plots display a single running enrichment score line each, with no error bars present.

individual-data-points.explanation: Bars show log2 fold-change values from a single DEG statistical comparison between conditions, not an average of replicate measurements, so individual data points are not applicable here.

error-bars-defined.explanation: The bar graph shows single fold-change values with p-values annotated above bars; no error bars are displayed.

individual-data-points.explanation: Panel E contains H&E and IHC micrographs, not a quantitative plot.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Panel E contains H&E and IHC micrographs, not a plot, so error bars do not apply.
